prayer: Lord, I am afraid right now and I am not going to pretend otherwise. My heart is racing and I don't feel steady. I don't need the fear to vanish — I just need to know you are here in it with me. Hold me. You have not left.

God, my mind won't slow down. I keep turning the same things over and I can't find the bottom of it. I don't know how to stop, so I'm bringing it to you instead. Take what I can't carry. You know every thought before I think it, and you are not overwhelmed by any of it.

I have too much on me right now, Lord. Too many things pressing at once and I don't know which way to turn. I'm not asking you to fix all of it. I'm just asking you to be present with me in the middle of it, because I can't do this alone today.

Father, I am so tired. Not just in my body — tired in places I don't have words for. I have been holding on for a long time. I am giving you permission to carry this, because I genuinely cannot anymore. Restore what has been worn down. I trust you with my exhaustion.

Lord, I have nothing left. I came to you empty-handed because empty-handed is all I have. You said you give power to the faint. I am faint. I am not asking for strength to do more — just enough to get through this moment, and then the next one.

God, I am grieving and I need you to know that I am not okay. Something precious is gone and the weight of that is real. I don't need comfort that rushes past this. I need you to sit with me in it. Weeping may last the night — I believe morning comes. But right now it is still night, and I need you here.

My heart is broken, Lord. Not bruised — broken. And I don't know how to move through this. You are close to the brokenhearted. That is the only thing I am holding onto right now. Be close. Be near. Let me feel that you have not looked away from this.

Father, I feel completely alone right now, even in a room full of people. That loneliness is real and I am bringing it to you honestly. You know my name. You have not forgotten me. Help me feel the truth of that in a way that reaches past my head and into the part of me that aches.

Lord, it feels like everyone has left, or like I was never truly held by anyone. I know that feeling is not the whole truth, but it is what I feel. You said you would never leave. I am asking you to make that real to me right now, not as a fact I know, but as a presence I can feel.

God, I feel ashamed. I don't want to come to you with this but I have nowhere else to go. You already know everything and you have not turned away. A broken and contrite heart you will not despise — I am holding you to that. Receive me as I am. That is all I can offer right now.

Lord, I am in a dark place and I don't have the energy to dress that up. Hope feels very far from me right now. I am crying out from the depths because that is where I am. You have been in the depths before me. Meet me here. I cannot climb toward you right now, so I am asking you to come to where I am.

Father, I can't be still. Something in me keeps moving, keeps reaching, and I don't know what it's looking for. I think it might be looking for you. Quiet me. Not to silence me, but to settle me — the way a child settles when they are finally held. I want to stop striving and simply rest in you.

It's morning again. I didn't think I'd be here, and yet here I am. Some days the gratitude comes easy. Today it doesn't, but I'm saying it anyway, because I think the saying is part of how it gets real. Thank you for not being consumed. Thank you for the mercies that are new, even when I'm not.

You sing over me. I can barely hold the thought. The God who made the stars rests in love over me, and I spend my days afraid I'm too much or not enough. Help me believe what you've said about me. Help me sit still long enough to hear the song. You are good. You are good. You are good.

I don't feel strong, God. I feel like I'm holding everything together with shaking hands. But I'm here. I'm still showing up. And maybe that's the strength — not the absence of fear, but the staying. Help me see what you see when you look at me. Help me believe I'm braver than I feel.

I'm scared. I won't pretend I'm not. But I'm asking you to walk this with me anyway. I don't need the fear to disappear — I just need to know you're closer than it is. Make me brave enough for the next step. Just the next one. I'll trust you for the rest as it comes.
